$comment: One Guarantee channel coverage. Channel numbers and names must equal docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's table. Each entry is a repo-relative test file and the exact title of a live it/test in it; tests/architecture/one-guarantee-coverage.verify.test.ts fails if any entry stops matching, or if a channel has no positive or no negative test in a file the `npm test -- verify` filter collects. Positive = the legitimate path yields the trusted outcome (a stub verify() that always says not_found would fail it). Negative = the forged/failed path never yields verified.
